summary: John's 7th-great-grandmother; daughter of Capt. Thomas Davenport of Philipstown and mother of Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux.
bio: Charity Davenport was a daughter of Capt. Thomas Davenport (1682-1759) of Philipstown; which of his wives was her mother is unchecked (the second wife Elizabeth was 'believed' to be a Leggett). In 1752 her father deeded Goshen-precinct land to 'Charity Lamoree, wife of John Lamoree', next to her brother Oliver Davenport. The 1919 Lamoureux Record calls her 'Charity Danforth' - 'Danforth's' was simply how people in the Hudson Highlands said 'Davenport's'; it even appears on Erskine's Revolutionary map of West Point.
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp. xvii, 355-361
